blocks.value: Every growing company eventually needs more money. It may want to build factories, hire employees, open new branches, or develop new products.
Imagine This: Your bakery is doing very well. Customers from other cities want your products. Opening ten new bakeries costs ₹5 crore, but you don't have enough money. You now need outside funding.
Companies usually have two main ways to raise money: borrow money as a loan, or invite people to become owners by buying shares.
Instead of borrowing huge amounts from banks, many companies choose to sell ownership through shares to raise capital.
Raising money from investors allows companies to grow without taking too much debt.
